name: Jigsaw Jam
hook: Build a fresh jigsaw together, piece by piece.
how: Every round paints a new picture and cuts it into 36 pieces. Drag pieces into the frame and they snap into place when they're close. A piece you're holding is yours until you let go, so nobody can snatch it. Finish fast to get on the board.
controls: Drag pieces with the mouse or a finger; drag the table to look around, scroll or pinch to zoom
uses: The host's browser decides who holds each piece and when one snaps; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Helper bots fit pieces alongside you when the room is quiet.
Everyone's cursor and the piece in their hand move live for the whole table.
ideas: Use 64 smaller pieces for a harder puzzle
Paint space scenes with planets and rockets
Let pieces turn, and right-click to rotate them
